left.raw_text: Patient presents with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) or stable coronary artery disease (CAD)
Patient is willing and able to provide informed written consent
Patient not able to receive 12 months of dual anti-platelet therapy
Patient or physician refusal to enroll in the study
Patient with known CYP2C19 genotype prior to randomization
Planned revascularization of any vessel within 30 days post-index procedure and/or of the target vessel(s) within 12 months post-procedure

OR.raw text: Anticipated discontinuation of clopidogrel or ticagrelor within the 12 month follow up period, example for elective surgery

left.raw text: Serum creatinine >2.5 mg/dL within 7 days of index procedure
Platelet count <80,000 or >700,000 cells/mm3, or white blood cell count <3,000 cells/mm3 if persistent (at least 2 abnormal values) within 7 days prior to index procedure.

OR.raw text: Known hypersensitivity to clopidogrel or ticagrelor or any of its components

left.raw text: Patient is participating in an investigational drug or device clinical trial that has not reached its primary endpoint

OR.raw text: Patient previously enrolled in this study

left.raw text: Patient is pregnant, lactating, or planning to become pregnant within 12 months

OR.raw text: Patient has received an organ transplant or is on a waiting list for an organ transplant

left.raw text: Patient is receiving or scheduled to receive chemotherapy within 30 days before or after the procedure

OR.raw text: Patient is receiving immunosuppressive therapy or has known immunosuppressive or autoimmune disease (e.g., human immunodeficiency virus, systemic lupus erythematous, etc.)

left.raw text: Patient is receiving chronic oral anticoagulation therapy (i.e., vitamin K antagonist, direct thrombin inhibitor, Factor Xa inhibitor)

OR.raw text: Concomitant use of simvastatin/lovastatin >40 mg qd

left.raw text: Concomitant use of potent CYP3A4 inhibitors (atazanavir, clarithromycin, indinavir, itraconazole, ketoconazole, nefazodone, nelfinavir, ritonavir, saquinavir, telithromycin and voriconazole) or inducers (carbamazepine, dexamethasone, phenobarbital, phenytoin, rifampin, and rifapentine)

OR.raw text: Non-cardiac condition limiting life expectancy to less than one year, per physician judgment (e.g. cancer)

left.raw text: Known history of severe hepatic impairment

OR.raw text: Patient has a history of bleeding diathesis or coagulopathy or will refuse blood transfusions

left.raw text: Patient has an active pathological bleeding, such as active gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding

OR.raw text: Inability to take aspirin at a dosage of 100 mg or less

left.raw text: Current substance abuse (e.g., alcohol, cocaine, heroin, etc.)
